outcome: Maternal satisfaction with the childbirth experience
cohort: The study included 555 postpartum women in Slovenia who participated in an online survey.
finding: Overall, women reported a high level of satisfaction with their childbirth experience, with the highest rating for timely contact with the newborn and lowest for birth environment and childbirth preparation.
mod_finding: Satisfaction varied significantly according to birth mode, with vaginal births and planned caesarean sections associated with higher satisfaction compared to emergency caesarean sections.
cross-section timing: Within one year after giving birth
